id: links-over-folders
title: Links over folders: a note filed in one place is lost to every other subject
evidence: inferred
status: unsettled
event_date: 2026-08-04
source: cc-session 2026-08-04
---

Every scheme I read this month makes the same choice. [[dewey-decimal-classification]] gives a book one number, and my old note folders gave a note one path. Anything that belongs to two subjects is filed under one and missing from the other. The [[zettelkasten]] gets around this by not filing by subject at all: a card sits behind whatever it continues, and links carry the subjects. Links only work if each note holds one thing, which is why [[atomic-notes]] matters to me more than the box itself.
